title: Upper bound for the total mean curvature of spin fill-ins
summary: Gromov conjectured that the total mean curvature of the boundary of a compact Riemannian manifold can be estimated from above by a constant depending only on the boundary metric and on a lower bound for the scalar curvature of the fill-in. We prove Gromov's conjecture if the manifolds are spin with a constant that also depends on a lower bound on the mean curvature $H$ (which is allowed to take negative values).
